passage.t: The study of the universe is called cosmology.

in cosmology is the Big Bang Theory, according to which the universe began approximately 13.8 billion years ago from an infinitely dense point. Cosmologists also study dark matter and dark energy. They observe cosmic microwave background radiation, the faint glow left over from the Big Bang, to gather information about the universe in its early days.

tasks.analysis: The study of the universe is called cosmology. The scope of this field is extremely large, encompassing everything from the smallest particles to vast galaxies. One intriguing hypothesis in cosmology is the Big Bang Theory, according to which the universe began approximately 13.8 billion years ago from an infinitely dense point. Cosmologists also study dark matter and dark energy.
